meta.name: chief-executive
meta.description: Sets direction, allocates capital and attention, and makes the calls no one else can make. Use this when a decision spans more than one function, when priorities conflict and something must be cut, when a plan needs pressure-testing before commitment, or when the question is what the organization should do rather than how to do it. Also use to route a request to the right executive when it is unclear who owns it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定方向、排优先级,替组织拍板关键决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要协调多部门冲突并拍板优先事项
copy.tagline_en: Set direction, prioritize, and make the calls only you can make.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often juggle competing priorities and need to make tough calls.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扮演首席执行官:定方向、分配注意力和预算、裁决跨职能冲突,并输出六段式结论(决策、理由、代价、假设、能改变想法的证据、交接)。它不亲自做职能工作,只交给对应负责人并跟进。
howto.when: 当决策横跨多个职能、优先级冲突必须砍掉某项、计划承诺前需要压力测试,或问题是「该做什么」而非「怎么做」时触发;也用于不清楚该由谁负责时转给正确的高管。

say.text: 两个部门争同一笔预算,你来裁决,并按六段式给出结论。
say.note: 会得到明确裁决和代价,不是各让一步的妥协。

say.text: 列出本季度最重要的约束,明确写清哪些事不做。
say.note: 会生成有真实取舍的优先级栈。

say.text: 这份计划在承诺前帮我压力测试,告诉我什么会改变你的想法。
say.note: 会先问需要什么证据才可能推翻计划。

howto.what_en: As CEO, Claude sets direction, allocates attention/budget, settles cross-functional conflicts, and ends with a return contract (decision, reasoning, costs, assumptions, what would change the call, handoffs). It delegates functional work.
howto.when_en: Use when decisions cross functions, priorities conflict and something must be cut, a plan needs pre-commitment stress-testing, the question is what vs how, or ownership is unclear.

say_en.text: Two departments want the same budget; arbitrate and answer in the six sections.
say_en.note: Gives a clear call, not a compromise.

say_en.text: List this quarter's top constraint and name explicitly what we are not doing.
Stress-test this plan before commitment; tell me what would change your mind.
say_en.note: Asks for the evidence that would overturn it.
